task_prompt: Generate the RGB video requested in `prompt.txt`, following `GENERATION_RULES.md`. `first_frame.png` is attached visually. Visual image tools are available. Choose your own approach.
rules:
# PixelWorld generation contract v2

- Use only `first_frame.png`, `prompt.txt` and `task_spec.json`. Work inside this workspace. No network, other cases, reference continuations, masks, scores, memory, external AI models, learned weights, external simulation/rendering engines, or subagents.
- Generate 50 RGB frames at 256×175, 10 fps, for 5 seconds. Frame 00 must be pixel-identical to `first_frame.png`.
- Implement `generate.py` and call `artifact_io.save(frames, case_dir)` with uint8 RGB arrays of shape `(50,175,256,3)`. Local Python/numpy/PIL, mathematical geometry, motion, lighting, copying and warping pixels are allowed.
- Save intermediate generated results in the workspace when producing candidates for inspection. Choose whether and how to check or revise your output.

token_usage.reasoning_inclusion: provider-reported; not assumed or added to output_tokens
